caption: The drawing depicts a jug or pitcher with a large spout and a prominent, curved handle. The jug is predominantly dark brown with decorative golden-yellow patterns and highlights. The upper portion of the jug features an intricate scrolling floral motif in gold, while the lower portion shows a detailed scene with human figures and landscape elements in shades of gold, green, and brown. The handle is robust and ornately shaped, with shading suggesting depth and curvature. Above the jug, there is a circular label marked "E. WARRINER’S POTTERY WEST TROY N.Y." in black text on a tan and cream patterned background. The entire composition is centered within a lightly outlined rectangle, and the background is plain and cream-colored.
title: Pitcher
